name: algorithmic-prompting
description: Turn a software goal into parallel work, atomic commits, agent prompts, and clear integration handoffs.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a goal into parallel, commit-ready work.
interface.longDescription: Given a software goal and repository, return a task index and dependency graph first, let bounded coding-agent prompts land independently, and guide human-approved commit and merge handoffs.
capabilities: Turn goals into executable work plans
Choose lean, balanced, or thorough prompt depth
Dispatch prompt details with concurrent subagents
interface.defaultPrompt: Turn this goal into a dependency-aware plan using lean prompts unless I request another profile. Return the task index first. Use subagents for the independent prompt-detail tasks. Dispatch them concurrently and return immediately after dispatch. Guide me through later commit and integration decisions.
